description.value: Liberty Wine Merchants is a Vancouver institution founded in 1986, built on a mission to source rare and artisan wines from small-batch producers worldwide rather than mass-market labels. The Granville Island location places it within one of Vancouver's most-visited waterfront destinations and a natural stop on the seawall cycling route. The shop carries an extensive range of wine, spirits, beer, cider, and sake.
